data.headline: Asbury Park agendas track entitlements alongside STHO’s development-site monetization strategy

claims.text: On September 23, City Council’s agenda contained 6 items concerning 320 Asbury Avenue and the Waterfront Redevelopment Area, including a financial agreement and tax exemption.

citation.quote: 2026-22 Ordinance Of The City Of Asbury Park Authorizing The Execution Of A Financial Agreement With PHM Drift at Asbury Park Urban Renewal LLC Concerning Property Located At Block 3801, Lot 1.021 (F/K/A Block 3801, a Portion Of Lot 1.02) 320 Asbury Avenue On The City Tax Map within The Asbury Park Waterfront Redevelopment Area And Granting A Tax Exemption

claims.text: On September 9, City Council’s agenda recorded 7 items involving Block 3801, 320 Asbury Avenue and the Waterfront Redevelopment Area, including a financial agreement.

citation.quote: 2026-22 Ordinance Of The City Of Asbury Park Authorizing The Execution Of A Financial Agreement With PHM Drift at Asbury Park Urban Renewal LLC Concerning Property Located At Block 3801, Lot 1.021 (F/K/A Block 3801, a Portion Of Lot 1.02) 320 Asbury Avenue On The City Tax Map within The Asbury Park Waterfront Redevelopment Area

claims.text: On September 28, the Planning Board agenda contained 1 item for a preliminary and final major site plan at 216 Cookman Avenue in the Waterfront Redevelopment Area.

citation.quote: 1. PB-2026-01 / The Views at Westley Lake / 216 Cookman Avenue / Block 3802, Lot 1 / APW Redeveloper, LLC / Preliminary & Final Major Site Plan / Waterfront Redevelopment Area / Prime Renewal Area

claims.text: On October 14, City Council’s agenda recorded 1 item to vacate part of St. James Place under the Waterfront Redevelopment Plan.

citation.quote: 2026-26 Ordinance Of The City Of Asbury Park, In The County Of Monmouth, State Of New Jersey, Readopting Ordinance 2953 And Vacating A Portion Of St. James Place Pursuant To N.J.S.A. 40:67-1, Et Seq. And The City’s Waterfront Redevelopment Plan

claims.text: STHO says its strategy is to monetize remaining development sites and operating assets through sales to third-party developers and operators while meeting its redevelopment-agreement obligations.

citation.quote: Our current strategy for the Asbury Park Waterfront investment is to actively asset manage our operating assets, and strategically monetize the remaining development sites and our operating assets through sales to third party developers and operators while meeting our obligations under the redevelopment agreement with the city of Asbury Park.

claims.text: The 10-Q identifies Asbury Partners as the joint venture owner and reports an approximately $120.9 million carrying value as of June 30, 2026.

citation.quote: We are the managing member in Asbury Partners, LLC, which is the joint venture that owns the Asbury Park Waterfront investment. The aggregate carrying value of the Asbury Park Waterfront investment was approximately $120.9 million as of June 30, 2026.
